LanguageData.CC_Settings_ItemCardFirst_Tip: Opening the info for food, a drink, a drug or medicine (the "i" button anywhere, a trade screen, a bill, a list, the inspect pane) opens Rimfolk's item card instead of the game's: what it is good for in this colony, its tags, how it keeps, who at home eats or takes it and why, the colony's stock and where it is made, and how traders value it. Its button "All the game's stats" opens the game's card, and the game's card keeps its button back. Links followed inside the game's card stay in it. Off, the game's card opens as before, with a button to Rimfolk's card at its foot. Materials, art and the rest come later.
LanguageData.CC_SetNote_ItemCardFirst: Food, drink, drugs and medicine open as Rimfolk's item card; the game's card is one button away.
LanguageData.CC_ItemCard_NotCovered: Rimfolk's item card shows food, drink, drugs and medicine for now; this opens in the game's own card.
LanguageData.CC_ItemCard_GameCard_Tip: Open the game's own info card for this, with every stat it lists. Its button "Rimfolk's item card" brings you back here.
LanguageData.CC_ItemCard_OpenCard_Tip: Open Rimfolk's card for this: what it is good for in this colony, its tags, how it keeps, who at home eats or takes it and why, the colony's stock and where it is made, and how traders value it.
LanguageData.CC_ItemCard_RotsAfter: Starts to rot after {DAYS} above 10 °C, slower in the cold, never at or below 0 °C.
LanguageData.CC_ItemCard_FrozenHere: This stack is kept cold: it doesn't rot where it lies.
LanguageData.CC_ItemCard_LeftHere: This stack: {DAYS} left where it lies ({TEMP}).
LanguageData.CC_ItemCard_PoisonStack: {CHANCE} for this stack, from its cook and kitchen.
LanguageData.CC_ItemCard_PoisonStackNone: None: nothing in this stack is poisoned.
LanguageData.CC_ItemCard_PoisonKind: {CHANCE}: its kind is risky for people.
LanguageData.CC_ItemCard_PoisonCook: By the cook: about {CHANCE} cooked by {COOK}, the colony's surest cook; a dirty kitchen adds to it.
LanguageData.CC_ItemCard_PoisonByCook: By the cook's skill and the kitchen; nobody at home cooks.
LanguageData.CC_ItemCard_RoadNot: The journey planner doesn't pack it.
LanguageData.CC_ItemCard_RoadFirst: The journey planner packs it first: it never rots.
LanguageData.CC_ItemCard_RoadEarly: The journey planner packs it early: a meal that keeps {DAYS}.
LanguageData.CC_ItemCard_RoadKeeps: The journey planner packs it after the meals made for the road; it never rots.
LanguageData.CC_ItemCard_RoadShort: The journey planner packs it for journeys it keeps through ({DAYS}), after what keeps longer.
LanguageData.CC_ItemCard_FeastDish: A feast's dish: a fine or lavish meal, what the Empire's guests expect.
LanguageData.CC_ItemCard_Why_wont: they won't eat this kind (their body, their genes or their title)
LanguageData.CC_ItemCard_Why_policy: their food policy leaves it out
LanguageData.CC_ItemCard_Why_fungusOrInsect: their beliefs keep them to fungus and insects
LanguageData.CC_ItemCard_Why_animalProduct: their beliefs forbid anything from animals
LanguageData.CC_ItemCard_Why_notFungus: their beliefs want only fungus among plants
LanguageData.CC_ItemCard_Why_drug: their beliefs rule out this drug
LanguageData.CC_ItemCard_NoEffects: No effect of its own that the game describes.
LanguageData.CC_ItemCard_AddictiveAfter: {CHANCE} a dose once tolerance is {TOLERANCE} or more.
LanguageData.CC_ItemCard_Overdose: Each dose adds {DOSE} toward an overdose, which kills at 100%.
LanguageData.CC_ItemCard_OverdoseLarge: {CHANCE} of doses are a large one.
LanguageData.CC_ItemCard_ToastAlcohol: Poured at Rimfolk's toasts for those who may drink.
LanguageData.CC_ItemCard_ToastSoft: Poured at Rimfolk's toasts for those who don't drink alcohol.
LanguageData.CC_ItemCard_GiftDrink: A fine drink: a gift between peoples, more often in the middle ages.
LanguageData.CC_ItemCard_UseGame: The game gives it to whatever the patient's medical care allows.
LanguageData.CC_ItemCard_UseMinor: With medicine by what is treated, Rimfolk gives it to cuts, bites, small burns and everyday ailments; the serious get better medicine where their care allows.
LanguageData.CC_ItemCard_UseSerious: With medicine by what is treated, Rimfolk keeps it for the serious: heavy bleeding, deep wounds, a vital part, illness and infection; scratches get herbal medicine or none.
LanguageData.CC_ItemCard_UseBest: With medicine by what is treated, Rimfolk keeps it for the serious where the patient's care is set to the best: surgery and the gravest wounds.
LanguageData.CC_ItemCard_UseSurgeryRisk: Surgery with it fails more often than with industrial medicine.
LanguageData.CC_ItemCard_DoctorLine: Medicine {LEVEL}: tends at {WITH} with it, {WITHOUT} without
LanguageData.CC_ItemCard_NoDoctors: Nobody at home has doctoring on.
